snippet.title: The Entire History of the World Cup (In 4 Minutes)
snippet.description:
How the World Cup Became the Biggest Event on Earth
Over 1.5 billion people watched the last World Cup final—that’s nearly a fifth of humanity. The Super Bowl gets a hundred million on a good day; the Olympics maybe half a billion. Nothing on earth compares to the scale of the World Cup. But how did a sport invented by English schoolboys become the single most watched event in human history?
In this video, we track the hidden history of football's global conquest. It’s an insane story involving the British Empire, cold war politics, an obsessive Swiss administrator, a devastating tragedy at the Maracanã in 1950, and the television revolution that turned a simple game into a global religion.
If you love deep-dive sports history documentaries, high-speed infographic explainers, and hidden history, make sure to hit that Subscribe button! We drop deep dives like this regularly.
